LESSON: WRITING 8.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.4: Writing 8.4.1 Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 8.4.1 Spelling, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should people spell words correctly? 2. How do we learn to spell words or names?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. spell words with the target letter - sound combinations from a dictation.

2. write 4-7 letter words with the target letter- sound combinations read to them.

3. make 4-7 letter words related to the theme from jumbled letters.

4. participate in spelling word drills with peers.

5. generate as many words related to the theme as they can from a set of their names.

6. type words made on a digital device with assistive technology. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. spell words with the target letter - sound combinations from a dictation.
2. write 4-7 letter words with the target letter- sound combinations read to them.
3. make 4-7 letter words related to the theme from jumbled letters.
4. participate in spelling word drills with peers.
5. generate as many words related to the theme as they can from a set of their names.
6. type words made on a digital device with assistive technology. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 8.4.1 Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration; the learner’s writing skills are improved as they write 4-7 letter words clearly and correctly.

• Digital literacy; the learner’s interaction with digital devices with assistive technology is enhanced as they type words onto a digital device with

assistive technology.

Values:
Unity; cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers in a spelling word drill.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-esteem); the learner’s self-esteem is enhanced as they spell words correctly for effective communication.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Correct spelling of words is emphasized in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.
